source.product: 96mm Mecanum Wheel Set (70A Durometer Bearing Supported Rollers)
source.assemblyVersion: Official goBILDA product CAD ZIP; files dated 2021-01-12 in the ZIP directory listing.
source.description: Official 96 mm wheel STEP assemblies, including all side plates, core, 10 roller assemblies, and fasteners. The STEP has no color assignments.

assetContract.origin: center of the source full-assembly bounding box; post-simplification output center residual is recorded per asset
assetContract.axleAxis: +Z/-Z (unchanged from the official STEP; wheel face lies in XY)
assetContract.orientation: +X right, +Y up, +Z toward the viewed wheel face. Wheel rotation is about local Z.
assetContract.positiveWheelSpeed: Rotate about -Z for positive physical wheel speed, as expected by the robot assembly contract.
assetContract.handedness: At the ground-contact roller nearest -Y, project its axle direction into XZ and choose the equivalent axis vector with +X component. Measure theta from +X toward +Z; the simulator traction vector is (+cos(theta), 0, -sin(theta)), so its signed angle is atan2(-axisZ, axisX). Left 3606-0000-0096 measures about -46.53 degrees at -Y; right 3606-0100-0096 measures about +46.43 degrees. Therefore wheel-left matches negative tractionAngle and wheel-right matches positive tractionAngle. At the opposite +Y side the signs reverse. The assets retain source orientation without mirroring or rotation.
assetContract.measuredDimensionsAndTriangles: Recorded per output below; dimensions are post-optimization scene-space bounds.

conversion.converter: tools/cad-convert/convert-step-to-glb.mjs (OpenCascade STEP tessellation and millimetre-to-metre conversion)
conversion.centering: --center; source assembly already has its wheel axle along Z
conversion.materialPolicy: Source STEP contains no colors. Part-name mapping assigns dark metallic steel to the side plates, black rubber to physical roller covers, dark polymer to the wheel/roller cores, and steel to fasteners, shims, and roller axles. STEP geometry is tessellated at the recorded deflection and simplified by gltfpack; roller barrels and plate apertures remain modeled.

transform.originPlacement: subtract the source assembly bounding-box center

rollerAxisMeasurement.plane: XZ projection of the 3D roller axle direction
rollerAxisMeasurement.method: Principal axis fitted to the official STEP roller-cover vertices; use the roller barrel centered nearest the indicated wheel pole, with its projected axis represented by the equivalent vector having +X component.
rollerAxisMeasurement.angleConvention: theta = atan2(-axisZ, axisX), matching the simulator's (+cos(theta), 0, -sin(theta)) traction vector; the unoriented axle line is represented with +X component

assets.geometryPolicy: Official assembly geometry, tessellated at the recorded deflection and simplified by gltfpack; roller barrels and side-plate apertures remain modeled.
